question: 20:94/q16
position: Some authorities count 216 supplementary yāʾs by including ألا تتبعن in Ṭā Hā and إن يردن الرحمن in Yā Sīn.
reasons: Nashr reports this alternative count and its two added instances.

question: How is the first-person yāʾ in بِرَأْسِىٓ إِنِّى read?

positions.position: The yāʾ of bi-raʾsī is opened with fatḥa before innī.
positions.reasons: Ibn Mujāhid reports that Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr open the listed first-person yāʾs apart from their named exceptions, which do not include bi-raʾsī innī.

positions.position: The yāʾ of bi-raʾsī has sukūn before innī.
positions.reasons: Ibn Mujāhid explicitly assigns sukūn at bi-raʾsī innī to Ibn Kathīr, and reports that Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, Ibn ʿĀmir and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim use sukūn on all the listed first-person yāʾs.

turns_on: Whether the first-person yāʾ is opened or given sukūn before innī.
